module.purpose: Provides the React inspector monitor for Redux DevTools, coordinating action selection, state inspection, diff generation, theme rendering, and monitor commands.
module.summary: This module implements a generic React class component that derives inspected action and state data from lifted Redux DevTools state, computes state deltas, and renders action navigation alongside an action/state preview. It maintains responsive layout state, synchronizes derived data when monitor inputs change, dispatches DevTools commands for action manipulation, and exposes reducer-backed update behavior through the exported component contract.
module.businessContext: Supports developer-facing Redux state debugging and time-travel inspection. Failure removes visibility into action history, state differences, and monitor controls.

detail.name: handleSelectAction
preconditions: The event argument provides a boolean shiftKey property.
this.props.monitorState provides selectedActionId and startActionId values that are either numbers or null.
actionId is a number.
postconditions: When Shift is held and an action is already selected, the computed selection covers the clicked action and the existing selection according to the ordering rules.
When Shift is not held, or no action is currently selected, the computed startActionId is null.

Clicking the currently selected action, or clicking while an existing range start is present without a qualifying Shift selection, computes a null selectedActionId; otherwise the clicked action becomes selected.
invariants: A computed non-null range has startActionId no greater than selectedActionId.
The existing selected action is used as the anchor only when Shift is held and selectedActionId is non-null.
Existing startActionId is preserved as a range boundary only during Shift-selection.
edgeCases: Without Shift, a click on the currently selected action computes selectedActionId as null.
Without Shift, a click on a different action computes that action as selected and clears the range start.
With Shift and no prior selected action, the method does not enter range-selection logic and clears the range start.
With Shift and an existing selection but no startActionId, the clicked and selected action IDs are ordered using min and max.
With Shift and an existing range start, clicking at or after the start preserves the lower of the existing start and selected IDs as the start and uses the clicked ID as the selected endpoint.
With Shift and an existing range start, clicking before the start uses the clicked ID as the start and the greater of the existing start and selected IDs as the selected endpoint.
detail.summary: Computes an action-selection range from the clicked action, Shift-key state, and the current monitor selection. It supports extending, reversing, and clearing selections according to the existing monitor state.
